title: Inline huddle cues and contextual primers for rollout & cost pages
creator: Ava Martinez
description: Design lightweight, context-sensitive "huddle cues" — ephemeral micro-guides that appear on rollout and cost dashboard flows to help engineers and PMs complete common tasks. These cues are meant to live in the surface (top-left cue card, inline callouts, and a persistent 'learn more' footer) and should be: ephemeral, non-blocking, keyboard accessible, localizable, and measurable. Deliverables: Figma screens, interactive prototype, copy variants for A/B, accessibility notes, and handoff tokens for dev.
acceptance_criteria: Prototype demonstrates huddle cue at three trigger points: initial rollout creation, canary expansion, and cost anomaly drill-in
Cue variants include short, medium, and long copy with clear next action buttons (e.g., 'Start canary', 'View cost breakdown')
Design tokens exported and annotated in the Figma handoff file; aria labels and focus order documented
Performance hooks and metrics list (impressions, clicks, conversion to rollout completion) added to console analytics team doc
Engineering sign-off on implementation feasibility with fallback when user has dismissed the cue
